title: Asphalt 3: Street Rules
statusNote: Language menu, attract demo, menus and an Instant Play race in landscape, with correct 3D and with its music (MP3), at 11 to 13 fps on a fast laptop. In about one start in three it quits by itself within the first minute or while a race loads (a fault of the emulator, under investigation); starting it again works, and its CI test starts it up to three times. The dump is a community release without signatures, which the N-Gage application refuses, so the player installs the game directly.
notes: Sometimes quits by itself soon after starting: start it again.
The phone is turned to landscape by the game, 320×240.

controls.source: Watched in play during the bring-up: the language, sound and menu screens, and an Instant Play race.
